main.description: Space policy that governs access via a member list maintained by the space host, managed with putMember and removeMember.

readAccess.description: Who the authority authorizes to read: any user, or members whose entry has read set.

writeAccess.description: Whose writes the authority tracks and forwards notifications for: any user, or members whose entry has write set.

allowedApps.description: If set, only these apps may access the space, evaluated against the attested client_id. When omitted, any app may access the space and no client attestation is required.

publishPolicy.description: Publish the policy to readers as a com.atproto.space.policy record in the authority's repo in the space.

publishMembers.description: Publish the member list to readers as com.atproto.memberspace.member records in the authority's repo in the space.
